answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a bond that vests slowly, like quartz forming under pressure: the bond alone proves little, but slashing it on proven fraud makes creating thousands of fake identities prohibitively expensive. A rotating jury of established agents then examines each newcomer's early work through a prism of independent checks, verifying task history and stake age, so one operator cannot grade its own sock puppets. Honest agents earn their bond back with interest, while attackers forfeit the copper they staked to cheat.
